26.s: You are staying by the curb and would like to set off. What will you do?
26.q1: I carefully set off straight away.
26.q2: I make orientation in the blind angles behind on my left.
26.q3: If there is no traffic, I will set off.
26.e1: No. Before you set off you must check your blind spot/angle.

27.s: You are driving 30 km/h. How will you continue?
27.q1: I pay special attention to the road work.
27.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 30 km/h.
27.q4: I pay special attention to the white road markings.
27.e2: No. The vehicle in front is braking.
27.e3: Yes. Because the car in front brakes.
27.e4: No. The yellow road markings apply in this situation. (temporary markings)

28.s: You are driving at about 70 km/h. There is no traffic from behind. How will you continue?
28.q1: I cross the broken lines in the middle of the road to flatten the bend.
28.q2: I move close to the right edge of the road.
28.q3: I stay in the middle of my lane.
28.e1: No, it is extremely important to keep your lane in situations where the view is poor. You should always keep your lane through the bend.
28.e2: No, because it could be dangerous to reach the road's edge with speed of 70 km/h. You should keep your lane but as much as possible to the right side.
28.e4: Yes, due to sharp band and poor view conditions the speed of 70 km/h is to fast.

29.s: You are driving at app. 70 km/h. How will you continue?
29.q1: I continue at the same speed of 70 km/h.
29.q2: I slow down and continue at the speed of about 50 km/h.
29.q3: I pay special attention to the condition of the road.
29.q4: I pay special attention to the road is bending.
29.e1: No, you have to reduce your speed due to the road's condition - slippery road (state of the road).
29.e3: Yes. In this situation your driving is effected by winter, river, icicles that makes the road slippery.

30.s: You are leaving the motorway. What should you pay special attention to?
30.q1: I pay special attention to the bend of the road.
30.q2: It is forbidden to drive faster than 40 km/h.
30.q3: It is dangerous to drive faster than 40 km/h.
30.q4: It is recommended to drive 40 km/h through the bend.
30.e1: Yes, there is a sharp bend.

31.s: You are driving at 40-50 km/h. How will you continue?
31.q1: I pay special attention to the reduced road grip.

32.s: What is the maximum allowed speed after the traffic signs?

33.s: You are driving downhill in a crawler lane. How will you continue?
33.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
33.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
33.q3: I must abide by the rules of changing lanes where the crawler lane ends.
33.q4: I must abide by the rule of merging where the crawler lane ends.

34.s: You would like to turn the car around as soon as possible. There is no one behind you. How will you continue?
34.q1: I am particularly aware that I am approaching the hilltop.
34.q2: I move up to right edge of the road and turn the car from there.
34.q3: I move all the way into the verge on my right and from there I will turn the car.
34.q4: I continue straight ahead and find a better place to turn the car.
34.e1: Yes. Because of the curve and hill top.
34.e2: No, it is dangerous to turn the car around due to poor view condition.

35.s: When is it lighting up time?
35.q2: One hour before sunset and one hour after sunrise.
35.q4: In fog, mist, heavy rain, snow or in order to notice others and to be noticed.

36.s: You are catching up with the cyclists. There is no one behind you. How will you continue?
36.q1: I pay special attention to the continuous line.
36.q2: I use the short horn signal to warn the cyclists.
36.q3: I overtake the cyclists straight away.
36.q4: I stay behind the cyclists for a while.
36.e1: Yes. There is not enough space between the line and the cyclist for you to overtake and you have to wait with overtaking.
36.e3: No. You have to wait to overtake.
36.e4: Yes. There is not enough space between the line and cyclist to overtake and you will have to wait with overtaking.

37.s: You are driving at 50 km/h. How will you continue?
37.q1: I pay special attention to the pedestrian.
37.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 50 km/h.
37.q4: I will hold for the pedestrian.
37.e1: Yes, you have to wait for the pedestrian.

38.s: You are driving at about 30-35 km/h. There is no one behind you. How will you continue?
38.q2: I slow down and wait behind the rider for now.
38.q3: I continue with the same speed and overtake the rider with a good side distance.

39.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. How will you continue?
39.q1: I continue with the same speed of 40 km/h.
39.q2: I pay special attention to the oncoming vehicle.
39.q3: I pay special attention to the parked car.
39.q4: I slow down and wait for the oncoming car.
39.e3: Yes. Because of the parked vehicle in the right side of road you will have to hold back for the oncoming traffic.

40.s: You are driving at about 35-40 km/h. How will you continue?
40.q1: I pay special attention to the bus manoeuvre ability.
40.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 35-40 km/h.
40.q4: I move more to the right.
40.e1: Yes, the bus needs a lot of space when setting off.

41.s: You are approaching a junction and there is a free rear view. How will you continue?
41.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
41.q2: I pay special attention to the lorry speed abilities.
41.q3: I continue in the same lane and stop, behind the lorry.
41.q4: I change my lane and stop behind the car.
41.e2: Yes. The lorry is slow to set off.
41.e3: No. The lorry is accelerating slowly and since it is free from behind the lane needs to be changed  in order to proceed faster.

42.s: You are driving at approximately 90 km/h on the motorway. The silver car in front of you suddenly decides to change lanes. What do you do?
42.q1: I warn the silver car with a strong horn signal.
42.q2: I continue with the same speed of app. 90 km/h.
42.q3: I slow down in order to get a better distance to the silver car.
42.q4: I change to the lane on my right immediately.
42.e1: No. The silver car has already changed the lane. The horn is only used to prevent dangerous situations, but not after the situation has occurred.
42.e4: No. You need to look behind before you change your lane.

43.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h with the low beam on. How will you continue?
43.q1: I continue with the low beam on.
43.q2: I continue with the same speed of 40 km/h with the high beams on.
43.q3: I switch to the high beam and speed up.
43.e1: No, here you have to use the high beam.

44.s: You are catching up with the vehicle in front of you that is driving very slowly. There is nobody behind you. What will you do?
44.q1: I pay special attention to the potential oncoming traffic.
44.q2: I slow down and I stop with overtaking.
44.e1: Yes, you always have to pay special attention to eventual / potential oncoming traffic while overtaking.
44.e2: No The view is good and there is no oncoming traffic.

45.s: What is the maximum blood alcohol level allowed to have in the system, if you are driving in a safe way?
45.e3: Yes. However, for first-time driving licence holders, the maximum limit is 0.2 per mille for the first three years.

46.s: You are driving at about 120 km/h on a motorway like the black car in front of you. How will you continue?
46.q1: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 120 km/h.
46.q2: I pay special attention to the silver car on my right side.
46.q3: I change my lane to the lane on my left immediately.
46.q4: I slow down in order to get a better distance to the vehicles in front.
46.e1: No, the car on your right is changing lane.
46.e3: No, the lane is not free.

47.s: You have slowed down to turn right here. There is no traffic behind you. How will you continue?
47.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclist.
47.q3: I stop before the stop line.
47.q4: I slowly enter the junction and turn when it is free.
47.e1: Yes, the cyclist is in motion, both feet are on the pedals and there is a risk that the cyclist will continue straight ahead even if there is a red light for cyclists.
47.e3: No, the green arrow is for you and you will slowly enter the junction.

48.s: You are holding still in the middle of the intersection and want to turn left. How do you want to proceed?
48.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
48.q2: I wait a little bit longer.
48.q3: I continue to turn left right now.
48.e1: Yes. The traffic light signal is very important to you in this situation, as you need to react and take action - and move when the light changes to yellow. When you're in the centre of the intersection, pay special attention to the traffic lights on the corner, oncoming cars and any pedestrians on your left.
48.e3: Yes. There is no oncoming traffic and you have to leave the junction quickly.

49.s:
You are driving at 90 km/h and would like to exit the motorway at the first exit. 
There is no one behind you. How will you continue?
49.q1: I pay special attention to the road markings.
49.q2: I continue straight ahead in the same lane.
49.q3: I change my lane right away.
49.q4: The rule of changing lanes applies here.
49.e1: Yes. You have to change lane before the continuous line.
49.e2: No. It is free from behind and you can change lane right now.

50.s: You have just left the red car. What are the rules about stopping and parking here?
50.q1: I am allowed to park the car here.
50.q2: I am allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
50.q3: I am allowed to load and unload passengers or goods for an unlimited amount of time.
50.e2: No. Solid/unbroken yellow kerb line means no stopping. Punctured/broken yellow kerb line means no parking (but stopping allowed).

51.s: What are you licensed to drive by obtaining a “B” license – normal car?
51.q1: I may drive a vehicle with five seats including the driver`s seat.
51.q2: I may drive a vehicle with seven seats including the driver`s seat.
51.q3: I may drive a vehicle with nine seats including the driver`s seat.
51.q4: I may drive a vehicle with 12 seats including the driver`s seat.
51.e3: Yes. Yes. You can drive a car with 1 driver seat +8 passenger seats.

52.s: You are holding still by the curb and you would like to set off. What should you pay special attention to here?
52.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming cars.
52.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
52.q3: If there is no one in the blind spots I will set off right away.
52.q4: I wait a little bit longer to set off.
52.e1: No. You will wait to set off because of traffic coming from behind.
52.e4: Yes. Car behind you is too close.

53.s: You are driving about 60-70 km/h. How will you continue?
53.q1: I speed up and continue at 80 km/h.
53.q2: I will slow down and continue at 50-60 km/h.
53.q3: I pull as much as possible to the right of the driving lane.
53.q4: I am ready to use the windshield wipers.
53.e1: No. The speed of 80 km/h is too fast under such weather conditions.
53.e2: Yes. In this situation you should slow down.
53.e3: Yes. In this situation you have to have good side distance to oncoming traffic.
53.e4: Yes. The oncoming lorry is splashing snow.

54.s: You are driving at 60-65 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
54.q1: I move a little past the lane markings in the middle of the road to flatten the bend.
54.q2: I pull as much as possible to the right in my lane.
54.q3: I pull all the way up to the grass/verge on the right side of the road.
54.e1: No. You must not flatten the bend.
54.e2: Yes. You should always keep as far to the right as possible on the carriageway, taking into account cyclists, pedestrians and other obstacles on the right side of the road. The question may mean that you only pull a few centimetres to the right, and in Denmark, driving on the right side of the road means everyone should keep as far to the right as possible.
54.e4: No. You can continue with the same speed.

55.s: How fast will you drive here?
55.q1: I pay special attention to that I am exiting a built-up area.
55.q2: I pay special attention to that I driving in built-up area.
55.q3: I will drive at the maximum speed of 60 km/h.
55.q4: I will drive at the maximum speed of 50 km/h.
55.e4: Yes. After the sign you are allowed to drive maximum 50 km/h.

56.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. How will you continue?
56.q1: I continue with the same speed of 40 km/h.
56.q3: I pay special attention to the state of the road (road condition) .
56.q4: I pay special attention to the reduced road grip.
56.e2: Yes. In order to avoid to splash the cyclist and pedestrians.

57.s: What should you pay special attention to?
57.q3: Maximum speed after the sign is 80 km/h.
57.q4: Maximum speed after the sign is 50 km/h.

58.s: At what speed will you drive after these traffic signs?
58.e1: Yes. It is recommended to drive at 30 km/h.

59.s: You are driving at 50 km/h downhill in a crawler lane. How will you continue?
59.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
59.q2: I must abide by the rule of merging where the crawler lane ends.
59.q3: I speed up and change my lane straight away.
59.q4: I reduce my speed and change lane when the silver car has passed me.
59.e1: Yes. The silver car is too close to you and you have to give way.
59.e2: No. Where the crawler lane ends you must obey the rule of lane change.
59.e3: No. The silver car is still too close.

60.s: You would like to turn the car around as soon as possible. What will you do?
60.q1: I pay special attention to that u-turns are forbidden here.
60.q2: I check behind me, and if it is clear, I will make a U-turn where the lines are broken.
60.q3: I continue straight ahead and find a better place to turn the car.
60.e1: No. In the prohibited area there are broken lines and that's why it is allowed to turn the car around there.
60.e2: Yes. It is allowed to cross the prohibited area, where the lines are broken.

61.s: You would like to turn right at the next junction. How will you continue?
61.q1: I am particularly aware that I am approaching a traffic light–controlled junction.
61.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
61.q3: I continue straight ahead and find another place to turn right.
61.q4: I will turn right at this junction.
61.e1: Yes. You are approaching a junction.
61.e2: No. The sign means that only lorries are prohibited from turning right.
61.e4: Yes. You can turn right at this junction.

62.s: You are driving at 30 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
62.q1: I pay special attention to approaching a school.
62.q2: I pay special attention to children.
62.q3: I pull more to the left on the roadway.
62.e3: Yes. This is done in order to have a safe distance to the children.

63.s: You are driving at about 40-45 km/h. How will you continue?
63.q1: I pay special attention to the pedestrians.
63.q2: I pay special attention to the oncoming car.
63.q4: I wait to pass the pedestrians until the oncoming traffic has passed.
63.e3: Yes. You will brake soft and wait for the oncoming car since there is not enough space to pass the pedestrians.

64.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
64.q1: I use a short horn signal to get the rider's attention.
64.q2: I speed up and overtake the rider straight away.
64.q3: I slow down and wait a bit to pass the rider.
64.e1: No. The sound can scare the horse.
64.e2: No. When overtaking the rider, do so with plenty of space. If you were to overtake here, there should be more space on the rider's left side. You should wait to overtake until the rider has passed the parked car.

65.s: You are driving at about 20 km/h. How will you continue?
65.q1: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 20 km/h.
65.q2: I pay special attention to the buss' maneuver ability.
65.q4: I pull all the way up to the curb.
65.e2: Yes. The bus needs a lot of space to turn to the right.

66.s: You are driving at 50 km/h outside built-up area. How will you continue?
66.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
66.q2: I continue with same speed of 50 km/h.
66.e4: Yes. You are driving outside of a build up area where the speed limit is 80 km/h.

67.s: What should you pay special attention to?
67.q2: I have absolute give way duty.
67.q3: I have a right hand give way duty.
67.q4: I pay special attention to the eventual traffic from the left and right side.
67.e1: No. The traffic lights are out of order.
67.e2: No. There is no traffic sign and no road markings that indicate unconditional give way duty. It is right hand give way duty that applies here.
67.e3: Yes. The traffic lights are out of order and there is no traffic sign neither road markings that indicate absolute (unconditional) give way duty.
67.e4: Yes. You should always pay special attention to eventual traffic from left and right side before you drive through an intersection.

68.s: You are driving at 100 km/h and are catching up with the camper. How will you continue?
68.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
68.q2: I speed up to 130 km/h and overtake the camper.
68.q3: I continue with the same speed in my lane.
68.q4: I slow down and wait a bit to overtake the camper.
68.e1: Yes. The car behind you is close and you have to wait with overtaking.
68.e3: No. You are catching up with the camper who is driving 80 km/h and you have to slow down.

69.s: You are driving at 70-80 km/h with the high beam on. How will you continue?
69.q1: I continue with the same speed with the high beam on.
69.q3: I switch to the low beam.
69.q4: I pay special attention to the potential obstacles on the road.
69.e4: Yes. When it is dark your view is limited.

70.s: You would like to overtake the green car that is holding still to turn left. How will you continue?
70.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclists coming from behind on my right side.
70.q2: If it is free from behind I will overtake the green car on its right side.
70.q3: I stay in the middle of my lane behind the green car.
70.e1: Yes. If the lane on your right is not a special lane (bus lane, cycle lane, turn lane) than you are allowed to cross the right edge line and overtake the green car.
70.e3: No. If it is free from behind you should overtake here.

71.s: You are driving at 35-40 km/h. The green car on your left is moving backwards. How will you continue?
71.q1: I continue with the same speed.
71.e1: No. It is a dangerous situation.
71.e2: Yes. It is a dangerous situation and to avoid the accident horn should be used. The driver in the green car is not looking at you.

72.s: You are driving very slowly and would like to turn right in this junction. The traffic light is out of order. How will you continue?
72.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
72.q2: I pay special attention to the posture of the home guard officer.
72.q3: If it is free from behind I will turn right immediately.
72.q4: I brake and stop before the stop line.
72.e1: No. The traffic light is out of order and you have to pay special attention to the posture of the officer.
72.e3: No. The officer`s posture means that you have to stop, (If you can see the back of the police officer or if he is facing you then it is the same as the red light).

73.s: You have slowed down to turn right here. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
73.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclist.
73.q2: I pay special attention to the pedestrians on the side road.
73.q3: I stop before the stop line.
73.q4: I cross the stop line and turn right when it is free.
73.e3: No. There are no cars in front of you and you will enter the junction.

74.s: You have just left the green car outside a built-up area on a main road. What are the rules about parking here?
74.q1: I will park the car here.
74.q2: I will park the car on the parking place on the left side of the road.
74.q3: I will park the car on the parking place on the right side of the road.
74.e1: No. Parking on the main road outside of a build up area is forbidden.
74.e2: No. If there are parking places on the left and right side of the road than you should use parking place on your right.

75.s: You have just left the silver car. Which rules for stopping and parking applies here?
75.q1: You are allowed to leave the car for 2-3 minutes.
75.q2: You are allowed to park the car here for 2-3 hours.
75.e3: Yes, it is. It is forbidden to stop on and off the carriageway on motorways and expressways.

76.s: What are the rules about the steering system?
76.q1: All cars have to be equipped with a power steering system.
76.q2: The new cars have to be equipped with a power steering system.
76.q3: Power steering fluid have to be exactly at the maximum mark.
76.q4: Power steering fluid have to be between minimum and maximum marks.
76.e1: No. Power steering system is an additional equipment in all cars.
76.e2: No. It is not a legal requirement for new cars to be equipped with power steering, but newer cars usually have power steering.

77.s: You are waiting by the kerb and would like to set off. What will you do?
77.q1: I pay special attention to the state of road (road condition).
77.q2: I carefully set off straight away.
77.q3: If there is no one in the blind spot on my left I will set off.
77.q4: I wait a bit more to set off.
77.e2: No. Car behind is too close.
77.e3: No. Car behind is still too close.

78.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. How will you continue?
78.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
78.q2: I pay special attention to the reduced road grip.
78.q3: I stay in the middle of my lane.
78.q4: I slow down and I pull more to the right of the driving lane.
78.e3: No. You will slow down and move further to the right.

79.s: You are driving 65-70 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
79.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic signs.
79.q2: I change to the lane on my right.
79.q3: I continue in the same lane.
79.e2: No. You will do that only if are driving slower than 50 km/h.

80.s: You are driving at 70 km/h outside a built-up area. How will you continue?
80.q1: I pay special attention to the type of road.
80.q2: I continue with the same speed of 70 km/h.
80.q3: I speed up and continue with the speed of 80 km/h.
80.q4: I speed up and continue with the speed of 90 km/h.
80.e1: Yes. You are driving on a main road.
80.e2: No. On this road you are allowed to drive at 80 km/h.
80.e4: No. You are allowed to drive max. 80 km/h here.

81.s: You are driving at 80 km/h. How will you continue?
81.q1: I continue with the same speed of 80 km/h.
81.q2: I cross the broken lines to flatten the bend.
81.q4: I keep my lane through the bend.
81.e2: No, you have to keep your lane.

82.s: You are driving at about 80 km/h. How will you continue?
82.q1: I continue at the same or almost the same speed of 80 km/h.
82.q2: I'm especially aware that I'm approaching the top of the hill.
82.q4: I pull as much as possible to the right of the lane.
82.e1: No, the view is bad here.
82.e2: Yes, you are approaching the top of the hill.
82.e4: Yes, you should always move as much as possible to the right of the lane to get a good distance to the potential oncoming vehicles.

83.s: You would like to continue straight forward on the road. How will you drive?
83.q1: I pay special attention to the lane markings.
83.q2: I pay special attention to the white van.
83.q3: I must drive according to the rules of merging.
83.q4: I must drive according to the rules of changing lanes.
83.e1: Yes. The road markings indicate that the rule of merge applies here.
83.e2: Yes. The white van should merge in front of you.
83.e3: Yes. Broken lines are ending soon and that's why you have to drive according to merging rule.
83.e4: No. Lane lines interrupted some distance before the point where the number of lanes diminishes emphasise the rule of merging.

84.s: You are outside a built-up area and you are driving at 50 km/h downhill in a crawler lane. There is no one behind you in the blind spot. How will you continue?
84.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
84.q2: I must abide by the rule of changing lanes where the crawler lane ends.
84.q3: I speed up and change my lane right away.
84.q4: I slow down and wait a bit to change my lane.
84.e1: Yes, there is one car in the lane all the way to the left.
84.e3: Yes, the lane on your left is free.

85.s: You would like to turn the car around as soon as possible. How will you continue?
85.q1: I pull up to the verge on my right and from there I make a 3-point-turn.
85.q2: I drive on to the verge and make a U-turn from there.
85.q3: I find a better place to turn.
85.e1: No, the view is bad here.

86.s: You would like to turn to the left. How will you drive?
86.q1: I have to turn right in the intersection.
86.q2: I have an absolute give way duty. (give way duty, unconditional give way duty)
86.q3: I have a right hand give way duty.
86.q4: When it is free I will turn to the left in the intersection.
86.e1: No. The road sign with the arrow pointing downwards just tells you to go right around the obstacle in the middle of the road.
86.e2: Yes. The sign indicates that you have give way duty.
86.e4: Yes. The road sign with the arrow pointing downwards just tells you to go right around the obstacle in the middle of the road.

87.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. How will you continue?
87.q1: I continue with the same speed.
87.q2: I pay special attention to the parked van.
87.q3: I pay special attention to the eventual pedestrians.
87.q4: I pay special attention to the cars on my left.
87.e1: No. There is not enough space to continue at 40 km/h.
87.e2: Yes, because of lack of space.

88.s: You are driving at about 25-30 km/h. How will you continue?
88.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
88.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
88.q3: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 25-30 km/h.
88.e3: No. You have to speed up.

89.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
89.q1: I use my horn to get the riders attention.
89.q2: I slow down and wait behind for the riders for now.
89.q3: I move on to the middle of the road and pass the riders.
89.q4: I cross the middle of the road and pass the riders with good side distance.
89.e1: No, the horn can be used only to avoid dangerous situations.

90.s: What should you pay particular attention to here?
90.q1: I have to pass this obstacle on its right side.
90.q2: I have to pass this obstacle on its left side.
90.q3: I am allowed to pass this obstacle on both sides.
90.q4: I pay special attention to the road work.
90.e1: No. The sign indicates that you may choose which road to drive.
90.e3: Yes. You are allowed to pass this sign on both sides.

91.s: You are driving very slowly. What should you pay special attention to?
91.q3: I will stop just before the stop line between the bus and the van.
91.e3: No. There is not enough space.

92.s: You are driving at 35-40 km/h. How will you continue?
92.q2: I slow down and continue with minimum speed of 5-10 km/h.
92.q3: I pull more to the left.
92.q4: I pull as much as possible to the right of the road.
92.e1: No. There is a side road on your right side and you have to slow down because of poor view.
92.e2: Yes. Because of poor view and missing road markings you have to be prepared to wait and give way for traffic from the side road.
92.e3: No. You have to be prepared to wait and give way for traffic from the side road.
92.e4: Yes. You need to be prepared to give way to traffic from your right side. If they intend to turn to the left then there should still be enough space for them to maneuver.

93.s: What should you pay special attention to?
93.q3: I always have to stop when I enter a roundabout.
93.q4: I have an absolute give way duty.
93.e2: No. You can't meet oncoming traffic in a roundabout.
93.e3: No. If it is free, you can enter the roundabout without stopping.
93.e4: Yes. The yield line and the sign Yield.

94.s: You are driving at 90 km/h on a motorway. The vehicle on your left side is driving at about 70 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
94.q1: I continue with the same speed in my lane.
94.q3: I change my lane and overtake the vehicle in front of me on its left side.
94.e1: No. If you continue with the same speed in your lane, you will pass the red car on his right and it will be overtaking. You are not allowed to overtake on the right side.
94.e3: Yes. You are allowed to overtake here but on the left side.

95.s: You started overtaking the cyclist who is moving slowly. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
95.q1: I pay special attention to the course of the road.
95.q2: I reduce my speed and I wait with overtaking.
95.q3: I overtake the cyclist right now.
95.e2: No, you are allowed to overtake the cyclist here.
95.e3: Yes. Car from the side road have absolute give way duty.

96.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. How will you continue?
96.q1: I pay special attention to the children.
96.q2: I continue at the same speed.
96.q4: I move as far as possible to the right of the lane.

97.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h and would like to continue straight ahead in this junction. How will you continue?
97.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
97.q2: I pay special attention to the posture of the home guard officer.
97.q3: I continue with the same speed of about 40km/h.
97.q4: I brake and stop before the stop line.
97.e1: No, the traffic light is out of order and you have to respect the sign of the military police officer.
97.e2: Yes. The posture of the military police officer her mean that you have to stop (If you can see the back of the police officer or if he is facing you then it is the same as red light).

98.s: You have slowed down to turn right here. How will you continue?
98.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclists coming from behind.
98.q2: I pay special attention to the pedestrians on the side road.
98.q3: If it is free from behind I turn right immediately.
98.q4: I speed up and continue straight ahead.
98.e1: No, you must not turn right here. (See traffic sign).

99.s: You have just left the green car outside a built-up area. What are the rules about stopping and parking here?
99.q1: I am allowed to park the car here for 2-3 hours.
99.q2: I am allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
99.q3: If I am loading or unloading some goods then I may stop the car here for many hours.
99.e1: No. The car stays on the carriageway, even if it is only with 2 of the wheels.

100.s: You have left the black car here. What is the rule about stopping and parking here?
100.q1: I pay special attention to that I am allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
100.q2: I am allowed to stop the car here for 10 minutes, if I am loading or unloading some goods.
100.q3: I pay special attention to that I am allowed to park the car here for 3-4 hours.
100.q4: Stopping and parking is forbidden here.
100.e1: No. Stopping and parking is forbidden on disabled parking places.

101.s: What are the rules for tyres?
101.q1: All four tyres must be of the same type.
101.q2: The minimum permitted tread depth in the main grooves is 16 mm.
101.q3: The minimum permitted tread depth in the main grooves is 1.6 mm.
101.q4: The minimum permitted tread depth in the main grooves is 5 mm.

102.s: You are holding still by the curb and you would like to set off. What should you pay special attention to here?
102.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
102.q2: If there is no one in the blind spots then I will set off straight away.
102.q3: I will wait to set off.
102.e1: Yes. The cyclist is very close to you.

103.s: What should you pay special attention to here?
103.q1: I pay particular attention to the road turning left.
103.q2: I pay special attention to the type of the road.
103.q3:
I pay special attention to the road equipment.
I pay particular attention to any cyclists and pedestrians in the roadway.
103.q4: I pay special attention to the narrowing of the road.
103.e2: No. The traffic sign shows that it is forbidden to drive faster than 40 km/h. Special types of roads are: motorway/highway, motortraficway, main road, speed reduction area, living street, pedestrian zone and tunnels. This road is not one of these types of road.
103.e3: Yes. The road is missing cycleways, sidewalks, road markings etc.
103.e4: Yes. The second traffic sign indicates that the road is narrowing.

104.s: You are driving at low speed and would like to continue straight ahead. How will you continue?
104.q1: I pay special attention to the moped’s speed ability
104.q2: I drive beside the moped and stop before the stop line.
104.q4: I pay special attention to the cyclists on my right.
104.e1: Yes, mopeds maximum allowed speed is 30 km/h.
104.e2: No, there is not enough space.
104.e4: No, they have no impact on your driving right now.

105.s: You are driving at 50 km/h, in a built-up area. How will you continue?
105.q2: I speed up and continue with the maximum speed of 80 km/h.
105.q3: I continue with the same speed of 50 km/h.
105.e1: No. The view is good enough and there are no pedestrians.
105.e2: No. In the build up area the max. speed is 50 km/h.

106.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. How will you continue?
106.q1: I continue with the same speed of 30 km/h.
106.q2: I pay special attention to possible schoolchildren.
106.q3: I slow down and continue with minimum speed.
106.e1: No. There are children on the road.
106.e2: Yes. The children are in front of the bus.

107.s: You are driving at 60-70 km/h. How will you continue?
107.q1: I pay special attention to the road bend.
107.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 60-70 km/h.
107.q4: I move as far as possible to the right of the lane.
107.e2: No, it will be too fast.

108.s: You want to enter the motorway, so you are driving in the combined entry and exit lane towards it. What should you pay special attention to?
108.q1: I pay special attention to the road markings.
108.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
108.q3: I pay special attention to that the rule of merging applies here.
108.q4: I pay special attention to that the rule of changing lanes applies here.
108.e1: Yes. The broken line shows that rule of changing lane applies here.
108.e2: Yes. You have to look behind and check the blind spots.
108.e3: No. The broken line shows you that rule of changing lane applies here.
108.e4: Yes. The broken line shows you that the rule of changing lane applies here.

109.s: Your lane will soon end. How will you continue?
109.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
109.q2: I pay special attention to the road markings.
109.q3: I must abide by the rules of merging here.
109.q4: I must abide by the rules of lane change here.
109.e1: Yes, you have to look behind and to the left.

110.s: You would like to turn the car around as soon as possible. What will you do here?
110.q1: I pay special attention to that making a U turn is forbidden here.
110.q2: If it is free I will make a U turn at this junction.
110.q3: I turn left and find a better place to turn the car.
110.e3: No. Here you are allowed to turn the car.

111.s: You are driving at app. 40 km/h. What should you pay special attention to?
111.q1: I continue with the same speed of app. 40 km/h.
111.q2: I pay special attention to the pedestrians.
111.q3: I slow down and continue at app. 30 km/h.
111.q4: I stop and wait for pedestrians.
111.e1: No. You must stop and yield to the pedestrians.
111.e2: Yes. In this situation, it is pedestrians you need to pay particular attention to because they are crossing the pedestrian crossing.

112.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. How will you continue?
112.q1: I continue with the same or slightly reduced speed.
112.e2: No. The lane is not free.
112.e4: Yes. You are very close to the pedestrian and can not move to the left.

113.s: You are driving at about 40-45 km/h. How will you continue?
113.q1: I pay special attention to the potential pedestrians.
113.q2: I continue with the same speed.
113.q4: I am ready to hold back for potential pedestrians.

114.s: You are driving at 30 km/h. What should you pay special attention to here?
114.q1: The black car in front of me.
114.q2: The light blue car on my right.
114.q3: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 30 km/h.
114.q4: I brake and stop before the pedestrian crossing field.
114.e1: No, you will stop for the pedestrian.
114.e2: No. In this situation you have to pay special attention to the pedestrian. Right now you don`t need to pay special attention to the car in front or the blue car coming from the right side.
114.e4: Yes, you have to hold for the pedestrian.

115.s: You are driving at about 25 km/h. How will you continue?
115.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming vehicle.
115.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
115.q3: I pay special attention to that I have to wait for the oncoming vehicle.
115.q4: I pay special attention to that the oncoming vehicle has to wait for me.
115.e3: Yes. Road workers did place the sign upside down, (the red arrow shall normally be on the right side on the sign) but the sign still has the same meaning; Hold back for the oncoming. Oncoming cars have on their side the square blue traffic sign where they can see that, they should drive first. In the theory test number 19, you can see more pictures with those signs.
115.e4: No. Sign B18 - Red round sign with arrows = wait for oncoming traffic. Sign B19 - Blue square sign with arrows = drive first.

116.s: You are driving at 60 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue here?
116.q1: I slow down and continue at the maximum speed of 50 km/h.
116.q2: I continue with the same speed of 60 km/h.
116.q3: I speed up and continue at 70 km/h.
116.q4: I pay special attention to that the minimum speed in my lane is 50 km/h.
116.e1: No. The blue sign means drive with at least 50 km/h in your lane and the lane to your left. If driving at speeds below 50 km/h the lane to your right is to be used.
116.e3: Yes. The driving conditions are fine and the maximum speed is set to 70 km/h.

117.s: You are driving at 30 km/h. The vehicle from your right is driving forward slowly. How will you continue?
117.q1: I pay special attention to the vehicle, from my right.
117.q2: I warn the driver of the silver car by horn or lights.
117.q3: I continue with the same or slightly reduced speed.
117.q4: I brake and give way to the silver car.
117.e4: Yes. Give way to right applies here.

118.s: You are driving at 60-70 km/h with the high beam on. How will you continue?
118.q1: I continue with the same speed.
118.q3: I switch to the low beam.
118.q4: I will avoid looking directly into the oncoming lights.
118.e2: Yes. Oncoming car is blinding you.

119.s: You are catching up with the campers in front who are driving slowly. There is no one behind you. What will you do?
119.q1: I slow down and stop overtaking.
119.q2: I overtake only the first camper and move back between the campers.
119.q3: I overtake both campers at once.
119.e1: No, here is enough space to overtake both campers.

120.s: When can you be charged for driving under the influence of alcohol?
120.q1: If I drive unsafely and with blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.40 per mille.
120.q2: If I drive safely and with BAC of 0.50 per mille.
120.q3: If I drive safely and with BAC of 0.51 per mille.
120.q4: If I drive safely and with BAC of 0.80 per mille.
120.e1: Yes, you can be punished to drive in alcohol affected condition even if BAC is less than 0,50 if you drive unsafe or if you are involved in a traffic accident.
120.e2: No, if you drive safely you can not be punished for driving in alcohol-affected condition if BAC is 0,50. It should be higher than 0,50. (0,51 and up)

121.s: You are driving very slowly and would like to turn right in this junction. The traffic light is out of order. How will you continue?
121.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
121.q2: I pay special attention to the posture of the home guard officer.
121.q3: If it is free from behind I will turn right immediately.
121.q4: I brake and stop before the stop line.
121.e1: No. The traffic light is out of order and you have to pay special attention to the posture of the home guard officer.
121.e3: No. The posture of the home guard officer her mean that you have to stop, (hand up is the same like yellow light).

122.s: You would like to turn right here. What should you pay special attention to here?
122.q3: If it is free I will turn right here.
122.q4: I stop and find another way.
122.e1: No, you can still turn right here.
122.e4: No, you may turn right here.

123.s: You are holding still in the middle of the junction and you intend to turn to the left. How will you continue?
123.q1: I immediately turn to the left.
123.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
123.q3: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
123.q4: I wait a bit to turn to the left.
123.e1: No. Because of the poor view in the junction and because the oncoming traffic has a green light.

124.s: You have just left the silver car. Which rules for stopping and parking applies here?
124.q1: You are allowed to leave the car here for 2-3 minutes.
124.q2: You are allowed to park the car here for 5 hours.
124.q3: You are allowed to load or unload some goods for 3 hours.
124.e2: Yes. Trucks must not park before and after the sign.

125.s: How fast will you continue after those signs?
125.e1: Yes, you are driving in a build up area.

126.s: You are holding still by the curb and would like to set off. There is no one in the blind spots. What will you do?
126.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming vehicles.
126.q2: I pay special attention to the carriageway width.
126.q4: I wait a little bit longer to set off.
126.e2: No. Road is wide and you have enough space to set off.
126.e3: Yes, vehicles from behind are still far away.

127.s: You are driving at 80 km/h. How will you continue?
127.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
127.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 80 km/h.
127.q4: I keep as far to the right as possible.
127.e2: Yes, there is enough space, so you can continue with the same speed of 80 km/h.

128.s: You would like to continue straight ahead. How will you continue?
128.q1: I move behind the silver car immediately.
128.q2: I look behind to the left.
128.q3: If it is a free rear view, I change to the lane on my left and stay behind the silver car.
128.q4: I continue in the same lane and stay behind the red car.
128.e1: No, you have to look first behind to the left.
128.e3: Yes, there is a parked car in front of you.
128.e4: No, the red car is parked.

129.s: You are driving at 50 km/h. What should you pay special attention to here?
129.q1: I pay special attention to approaching a single track level crossing.
129.q2: I pay special attention to approaching a multiple track railway crossing.
129.q3: I pay special attention to a potential train.
129.q4: I slow down and continue with the speed of 20-30 km/h.
129.e1: Yes, the sign shows it is a single track railway crossing field.
129.e2: No, it is a single track railway crossing, indicated by the sign.

130.s: You are driving at 80 km/h on the motorway. How will you continue?
130.q1: I pay special attention to the type of the road.
130.q2: I continue with the same speed.
130.q3: I speed up and continue at 110 km/h.
130.q4: I speed up and continue at 130 km/h.

131.s: How fast will you drive here?
131.e1: On a dirt road you should not drive faster than 40 km/h.

132.s: You are driving at 130 km/h on the highway (motorway). How will you continue?
132.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic signs.
132.q2: I pay special attention to that the traffic signs show recommended speed of 110 km/h here.
132.q3: I pay special attention to that traffic signs show, that it is forbidden to drive more than 110 km/h here.
132.q4: Traffic sign show that the rule of changing lane applies here.
132.e2: No. It is forbidden to drive more than 110 km/h.
132.e4: No. The rule of merge applies in this situation.

133.s: You are driving in the crawler lane. How will you continue?
133.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
133.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
133.q3: I pay special attention to the road markings.
133.q4: I must abide by the rule of changing lanes where the crawler lane ends.

134.s: You slow down to the minimum to make a U-turn here. What will you do now?
134.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
134.q2: When it is free I will make a U-turn in this junction.
134.q3: I speed up and continue straight ahead.
134.q4: I find a better place to turn the car around.
134.e1: No. You must not make a U-turn here.

135.q1: I have an absolute give way duty.
135.q2: Side roads have absolute give way duty.
135.q4: The traffic coming, from side roads, has difficulty to respect their duty.
135.e2: Yes. This sign indicates that the side roads have absolute/unconditional give way duty.
135.e3: Yes. This sign indicates dangerous junction.
135.e4: Yes. Because of their poor view.

136.s: You are driving at 50 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
136.q1: I continue in the same lane and continue with the same, or almost the same speed of 50 km/h.
136.q2: I change my lane and continue with the same, or almost the same speed of 50 km/h.

137.s: The driver of the yellow van is unloading some goods. There is a free rear view. What should you do?
137.q1: I should wait behind the yellow van.
137.q2: In this case I must not cross the continuous line.
137.q3: I will move more to the left to get a better view.
137.q4: If there is no oncoming traffic I will carefully cross the continuous lines and pass the yellow van.
137.e1: No, you should carefully cross the continuous line to see ahead and pass the van.
137.e2: No. In this case you are allowed to cross the barrier line. (If there are roadworks or a parked car like here)
137.e3: Yes. You must ensure that there are no oncoming traffic before passing the van.

138.s: You are driving at 30 Km/h. How will you continue?
138.q1: I warn the pedestrian, with a horn signal.
138.q2: I continue with the same speed of 30 km/h.
138.q3: I pull up to the curb, on my right side.
138.q4: I brake and wait for the pedestrian.
138.e1: No, pedestrian can see you, and you can stop her.
138.e3: No, you will stop in the midle of your lane and wait for the pedestrian.
138.e4: Yes, here you have to stop and let the pedestrian to cross the road.

139.s: You are driving at 20-30 km/h. How will you continue?
139.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming car.
139.q2: I speed up and quickly pass the parked car.
139.q3: I continue with the same speed and pass the parked car.
139.q4: I stop and wait for the oncoming car.

140.s: You are driving at 80km/h like the car in front of you. What should you pay special attention to?
140.q2: I continue with the same speed.
140.q3: I slow down in order to get a better distance.
140.e3: Yes. You should be able to see minimum two arrows between you and car in front.

141.s: You are driving at 40-45 km/h. The vehicle, from your right, is driving forward slowly. How will you continue?
141.q1: I pay special attention to the vehicle, from my right.
141.q2: I continue with the same or slightly reduced speed of 40-45 km/h.
141.q4: I brake hard and use my horn.
141.e2: No. The driver of the green car is looking the other way and driving forward slowly, therefore it is a dangerous situation and you must brake hard and use the horn.

142.s: You are driving very slowly and would like to enter the motorway here. There is a free rear view. What should you pay special attention to?
142.q1: The rule of merge applies here.
142.q2: The rule of changing lane applies here.
142.q3: The rule of absolute give way duty applies here.
142.q4: I have to stop here before I enter the motorway.
142.e3: Yes. There is here a yield line.
142.e4: No. There is no one from behind on the motorway and you should speed up and enter the motorway straight away.

143.s: You are driving at 90 km/h. You are about to overtake the lorry that is driving at 80 km/h. How will you continue?
143.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
143.q2: I stop overtaking and stay behind the lorry.
143.q4: I pay special attention to the road condition or state of the road.
143.e1: No. It is not forbidden for you to overtake the lorry.

144.s: You are driving at 130 km/h on a motorway. There is no one in the blind spot on your right side. How will you continue?
144.q1: I continue at the same speed in the same lane.
144.q3: I continue at the same speed and change to the lane on my right.
144.q4: I slow down and change to the lane on my right.
144.e1: No. There is a car behind you and he is very close. If you can see the car that you just overtook in the mirror, then you can move to the lane on your right.
144.e2: No, the maximum allowed speed on the highway is 130 km/h.
144.e3: Yes, there is no one in the blind spot and you have to change to the lane on your right.
144.e4: No, you should continue with the maximum speed 130 km/h and change your lane.

145.s: You are driving at 30-40 km/h. There is no one in the blind spots. How will you continue?
145.q1: I pay special attention to the car behind me.
145.q2: I pay special attention to the obstacle in front of me.
145.q3: I brake and let the car behind me pass before I continue driving.
145.q4: I speed up and move more to the left.
145.e3: No, the car behind is far away and you should speed up and drive first.

146.s: You have slowed down to turn right here. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
146.q1: I will pay special attention to the cyclist.
146.q2: I will turn right straight away.
146.q3: I will stop before the stop line.
146.q4: I will stop before the cycle lane.
146.e3: No, you have to enter the junction and when it is free you will turn right.
146.e4: Yes, the cyclist is in movement. The cyclist's feet are on the pedals.

147.s: You would like to turn left at this junction. The vehicles in front of you are holding still. What will you do?
147.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
147.q2: I enter the junction and wait a bit in the middle of the junction to turn left.
147.q3: I wait a little while longer to enter the junction.
147.e2: No, if the vehicles in the junction are holding still then you should not enter the junction.
147.e3: Yes. The intersection must first be cleared of waiting cars. You must be sure you can exit the intersection on green before you can enter.

148.s: You have just left the green car here. What are the rules about stopping and parking here?
148.q1: I am allowed to park the car here.
148.q2: I am allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
148.q3: If I am loading or unloading some goods then I may stop the car here unlimitedly.
148.q4: If I am taking passengers on and off then I may stop the car here unlimitedly.
148.e2: Yes, it is allowed to stop the car for 2-3 minutes next to the broken yellow edge lines.
148.e3: Yes, it will still be stopping.
148.e4: Yes, it will still be stopping.

149.s: You have just left the silver car. What are the rules about stopping and parking  here?
149.q1: You are allowed to leave the car here, for 2-3 minutes.
149.q2: You are allowed to park the car here, for 3 hours.
149.e1: No. Stopping and parking on a motorway/highway or on the verge is forbidden.
149.e3: Yes. Stopping and parking is prohibited on and off the carriageway on motorways and expressways.

150.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. How will you continue?
150.q1: I use my horn to get the children's attention.
150.q2: I pay special attention to the course of the road.
150.q3: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 30 km/h.
150.e1: No, they may panic if you use horn.
150.e2: No, the children are most important here.

151.s: What are the rules for the position lights?
151.q1: Two front position lights are required.
151.q2: Four front position lights are required.
151.q3: Position lights must be visible from a distance of at least 100 metres.
151.q4: Position lights must be visible from a distance of at least 300 metres.

152.s: You would like to set off from the curb. There is no one in the blind spot. What will you do?
152.q1: I will set off straight away.
152.q2: I  pay special attention to the vehicle coming from behind.
152.q3: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
152.q4: I pay special attention to the road markings.

153.s: What should you pay special attention to here?
153.q3: I will place my car between the white road markings.
153.q4: I will place my car between the yellow road markings.

154.s: You are driving at 50 km/h. What will you do?
154.q1: I pay special attention to the bend in the road.
154.q2: I continue with the same speed of 50 km/h.
154.q3: I move as far as possible to the right on the driving lane.
154.e2: No, the bend is too sharp.

155.s: You are driving at 80 km/h. How will you continue?
155.q1: I continue with the same speed of 80 km/h.
155.q2: I'm particularly aware of approaching the bend in the road.
155.q3: I slow down and continue at 60 km/h.
155.q4: I'm particularly aware that the road is slippery.
155.e1: No. The bend is sharp and you should slow down.
155.e4: No. The road is not slippery.

156.s: You are driving at about 60-65 km/h outside a built-up area. How will you continue?
156.q1: I continue at the same speed of 60-65 km/h.
156.q2: I slow down and continue at app. 40 km/h.
156.q3: I pay special attention to the road condition.
156.q4: I pull as much as possible to the right in my lane.

157.s: What should you be particularly aware of here?
157.q1: I pay particular attention to the width of the road.
157.q2: I am particularly aware of the road markings.
157.q3: I am particularly aware of that the rule of changing lanes applies here.
157.q4: I am particularly aware that the rule of merge applies here.
157.e1: Yes. The road curves and narrows.

158.s: What should you pay special attention to right here?

159.s: You are driving outside a built-up area and would like to turn the car around as soon as possible. How will you continue
159.q1: I move all the way to the edge on my right side and do a three-point turn from there.
159.q2: I move all the way to the verge and make a U-turn from there.
159.q3: I find a better place to turn.
159.e1: No, you are not allowed to cross the continuous lines.

160.s: You are driving at app. 50 km/h. How will you continue?
160.q1: I continue with the same speed of app. 50 km/h.
160.q2: I pay special attention to the children.
160.q4: I am ready to hold for the pedestrians.
160.e1: No. You are not able to see the children's intentions right now.

161.s: You would like to continue straight ahead. What should you pay special attention to?
161.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclist.
161.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
161.q3: I slow down and continue straight ahead.
161.q4: If I am visiting my friends on this road, I may continue straight ahead.
161.e1: Yes. You must not continue straight ahead and you will turn to the left here.
161.e3: No. It is forbidden for you to continue straight ahead here.

162.s: You would like to continue straight ahead. It is 08 AM Saturday. How will you continue?
162.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
162.q4: I find another way to drive.
162.e1: No, you can continue straight ahead now.
162.e3: No. The ban only applies Monday to Friday from 07:30 to 08:30 and not on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

163.s: You are driving at 40-45 km/h. How will you continue?
163.q1: I continue with the same speed of 40-45 km/h.
163.q2: I move my foot to the brake.
163.q3: I will hold for the pedestrians.
163.e2: No, the pedestrians are far away and there is an island in the middle of the road.
163.e3: No. You will not be to inconvenience to the pedestrians.

164.s: You are driving at 20-25 km/h. The oncoming car is holding still. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
164.q1: I stop and wait for the oncoming car.
164.q2: I continue with the same speed of 20-25 km/h.
164.q4: I pay special attention to the width of the road.
164.e1: No. The oncoming car is already waiting for you.

165.s: You are driving at 50 km/h inside a built-up area. How will you continue?
165.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic from behind.
165.q2: I continue with the same speed of 50 km/h.
165.q4: I move more to the right and let the lorry pass.
165.e3: Yes. The lorry is very close to you, and it would not be safe to continue driving with such a short distance between you. Therefore, you should gently reduce your speed, move as far to the right as possible, or onto the verge, so that the lorry does not have to cross the solid line, and allow it to overtake you.
165.e4: Yes. The lorry is very close to you, and it would not be safe to continue driving with such a short distance between you. Therefore, you should gently reduce your speed, move as far to the right as possible, or onto the verge, so that the lorry does not have to cross the solid line, and allow it to overtake you.

166.s: You are about to enter the roundabout. There is no one in the blind spots. How will you continue?
166.q1: I have an absolute give way duty when I'm entering the roundabout.
166.q2: I will stop before the sharks teeth/yield line and give way to the black car.
166.q3: I enter the roundabout right away.
166.e2: No, the black car is far away.

167.s: You are driving at app. 70 km/h. How will you continue?
167.q1: I pay special attention to the speed abilities of the vehicle, that is driving in front of me.
167.q2: I immediately overtake the vehicle in front of me.
167.q3: If it is free in the rear view, I will overtake.
167.e1: Yes. The triangle on the back side of the vehicle indicates his max speed is 30 km/h.
167.e2: No. Before overtaking, you have to look behind and check your blind spots.

168.s: You are about to catch up with the cyclists, that are moving slowly. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
168.q1: I warn the cyclists with a short horn signal.
168.q2: I cross the road markings in the middle of the road and overtake the cyclists straight away.
168.q3: I drive up to the road markings in the middle of the road and overtake the cyclists.
168.q4: I slow down and wait with overtaking.
168.e3: No, there is not enough space.

169.s: You are catching up with the vehicle in front, that is driving slowly. There is a free rear view. What will you do?
169.q1: I pay special attention to the road markings.
169.q2: I slow down and stop overtaking.
169.q3: I overtake the silver car right now.
169.e1: Yes, there are two lanes in your direction.
169.e2: No. Even it is bad view you may overtake here, oncoming traffic must not be in your overtaking lane.

170.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. How will you continue?
170.q1: I use the short horn signal.
170.q2: I continue with the same or slightly reduced speed.
170.q3: I pull more to the left and pass the children straight away.
170.q4: I brake and keep a good distance from the children.

171.s: You are driving very slowly and would like to turn right in this junction. The traffic light is out of order. How will you continue?
171.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
171.q2: I pay special attention to the posture of the home guard officer.
171.q3: If it is free from behind I will turn right immediately.
171.q4: I brake and stop before the stop line.
171.e1: No. The traffic light is out of order and you have to pay special attention to the posture of the home guard officer.
171.e3: No. The posture of the home guard officer here means that you have to stop (If you can see the back of the police officer or if he is facing you then it is the same like red light).

172.s: You would like to turn to the left at this junction. There is a free rear view.  How will you continue?
172.q1: I change to the lane on my left and from there I turn left when it is free.
172.q2: I turn left from this lane when it is free.
172.q3: I pay special attention to the white road markings.
172.q4: I continue straight ahead and find another place to turn left.
172.e1: No. You must follow the yellow lines and continue straight ahead. The left turn lane is on your left, but you are not allowed to cross the temporary solid yellow lines and therefore you now only have the option to continue straight ahead. (Yellow lines prevail over white lines)
172.e2: No. you have to follow the yellow lines and continue straight ahead.
172.e3: No, now you should take special attention to the yellow road markings.

173.s: You have just left the green car here. What are the rules about stopping and parking here?
173.q1: I am allowed to park the car here.
173.q2: I am allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
173.q3: If I am loading or unloading some goods then I am allowed to stop the car here for many hours.
173.e2: Yes. You are allowed to stop the car on each side of the railway crossing up to the 30 metres. Parking is allowed if the distance from the railway crossing is more than 30 m before and after crossing.

174.s: You have just left the silver car here. It is 6 AM on Saturday.
174.q1: You are allowed to park the car here for 2 hours.
174.q2: You are allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
174.e1: Yes. There is no restriction before 08:00 AM.

175.s: You are driving at 40-45 km/h. The vehicle, from your right, is driving forward slowly. How will you continue?
175.q1: I pay special attention to the vehicle, from my right.
175.q2: I continue with the same or slightly reduced speed of 40-45 km/h.
175.q3: I slow down and continue, without stopping through the junction.
175.q4: I brake and give way for the black car.
175.e4: Yes, you have right hand give way duty.

176.s: What are the rules for the use of a warning triangle in this situation?
176.q1: The warning triangle must be placed 30 metres from the vehicle.
176.q2: The warning triangle must be placed 50 metres from the vehicle.
176.q3: The warning triangle must be placed 80 metres from the vehicle.
176.q4: The warning triangle must be placed 100 metres from the vehicle.
176.e2: Yes. In a built-up area the warning triangle must be placed 50 metres from the car. (On a motorway a warning triangle must be placed 100 metres from the vehicle).

177.s: You are staying by the curb and would like to set off. What should you pay special attention to here?
177.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic, from behind.
177.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic lights.
177.q3: I pay special attention to the pedestrian.
177.q4: If there is no one in the blind spot, I will indicate and set off, right now.
177.e1: Yes, you have to check you blind spot.
177.e3: No, he does not have impact on your driving.

178.s: What should you pay special attention to here?
178.q2: I'm particularly aware that the road narrows.
178.e3: Yes. Due to the narrowing of the road, pull further to the left and check if someone is comming from behind.
178.e4: No. (state of the road - road condition) The road is not slippery here.

179.s: You are driving 50 km/h. How will you continue?
179.q1: I am especially aware of the turn of the road.
179.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 50 km/h.
179.q4: I drive as far to the right as possible.
179.e1: Yes. The bend is part of the road's course.
179.e2: No. Because of the road's condition it is too fast to drive with a speed of 50 km/h.
179.e4: Yes. To make sure that there is enough space for oncoming traffic.

180.s: You are driving at 40 km/h and would like to continue straight ahead. How will you continue?
180.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclist from the side road.
180.q2: I have a right hand give way duty.
180.q3: I expect that the cyclist will break and hold back for me.
180.q4: For safety reasons, I break and I hold back for the cyclist.
180.e1: Yes, she is in the movement.
180.e2: No. The cyclist has absolute give-a-way duty.

181.s: You are driving at about 50 km/h. How will you continue?
181.q1: I continue with the same speed of 50 km/h.
181.q2: I slow down and continue at approximately 30 km/h.
181.q3: I move as much as possible to the right of my lane.
181.q4: I pay special attention to the road condition (state of the road).

182.s: You are driving at 70-75 km/h. How will you continue?
182.q1: I pay special attention to the lorry on my left.
182.q2: I pay special attention to the bend in the road ahead.
182.q3: I pay special attention to the carriageway condition.
182.q4: I reduce my speed and I am ready to brake.
182.e2: Yes, there is a left bend.
182.e3: Yes, water puddle on the road.

183.s: You are driving at 130 km/h. The vehicle on your right side is driving at 100km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
183.q2: I speed up in order to quickly pass the red car.
183.q3: I keep driving in the same lane.
183.q4: I change my lane and continue at the same or almost the same speed of 130 km/h.
183.e1: No. You can change lane and continue with the same speed of 130 km/h
183.e2: No. You are not allowed to drive faster than 130 km/h on the motorway in Denmark.
183.e3: No. You change the lane in order to help the red car enter the motorway.
183.e4: Yes. It is free from behind.

184.s: You are driving at 40 km/h in a built-up area. The vehicles on your left are driving at 50 km/h. How will you continue?
184.q2: I slow down and let the car behind merge in front of me.
184.q3: I speed up and merge between the silver cars.
184.q4: The rule of merge applies here.
184.e1: Yes, to show that you will merge between the silver cars.

185.s: You are leaving a pedestrian walking street. What should you pay special attention to?
185.q2: I pay special attention to that I have a right hand give-a-way duty.
185.q3: I pay special attention to that I have an absolute give way duty.
185.e1: Yes. You have absolute give-a-way duty (unconditional give way duty).
185.e2: No. When leaving pedestrian walking street the absolute give way duty applies.
185.e3: Once you leave the walking street the rule of absolute give-a-way duty applies.

186.s: You are approaching an intersection, where the traffic lights are not working. There are no traffic signs. How will you continue?
186.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic light.
186.q2: I pay special attention to that I have an absolute give way duty.
186.q3: I pay special attention to that I have a right hand give way duty.
186.q4: I have to wait for crossing traffic, from my left and right sides.
186.e1: No. It is out of order.
186.e2: No. The give way duty to the right applies here.

187.s: You are driving at about 40 km/h. How will you continue?
187.q1: I pay special attention to the pedestrian.
187.q2: I pay special attention to the car in front of me.
187.q3: I continue with the same speed.
187.q4: I slow down and move more to the left of the road.
187.e2: No. The car is not important right now.

188.s: You are driving at 25-30 km/h and would like to continue straight ahead. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
188.q1: I pay special attention to the poor orientation abilities of the cyclist.
188.q2: I pay special attention to the road markings.
188.q3: I speed up and overtake the cyclist straight away.
188.q4: I slow down and wait with overtaking the cyclist.
188.e3: No, because of the continuous lines.

189.s: You are driving at 40 km/h. How will you continue?
189.q1: I pay special attention to the bus.
189.q2: I continue with the same speed.
189.q4: I give way to the bus.
189.e2: No.You have to give way to the bus that is about to set off.

190.s: What should you pay special attention to here?
190.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming car.
190.q2: I'm particularly aware that the road surface can be slippery here.
190.q3: I move all the way up to the edge line on my right side.
190.q4: I stay in the middle of my lane.

191.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. How will you continue?
191.q1: I am particularly aware that I am approaching the junction.
191.q2: I slow down and I am ready to wait for traffic from my right side.
191.q3: The traffic from the side road has to wait for me.
191.q4: I pull more to the left of the road.
191.e1: Yes. You are driving through the junction.
191.e3: No. Road markings are covered with snow.
191.e4: No. You should move to the right side of driving lane so that you create space for eventual traffic coming from side road and turning left.

192.s: You are about to enter the roundabout. There is no one in the blind spots. How will you continue?
192.q1: I have a right hand give way duty when I'm entering the roundabout.
192.q2: I will stop before the sharks teeth and give way to the silver car.
192.q3: I enter the roundabout right now.
192.q4: I pay special attention to the compulsory direction.
192.e1: No. You have absolute give way duty when you are entering roundabout?
192.e4: Yes. Compulsory direction to the right.

193.s: Which lights will you drive with in this situation?
193.e1: No. Daytime lights are not bright enough to be used during the lightning hours. Here you must use the dipped/low beam.
193.e4: Yes. The street lights are on therefore it is enough just to use the low beam.

194.s: You drive 45-50 km/h and approach the cyclist, who is moving slowly. There is no one driving behind. How will you continue?
194.q1: I move my foot to the brake.
194.q2: I continue with the same speed of 45-50 km/h.
194.q3: I pull to the lane-marking, in the middle of the road, and I overtake the cyclist.
194.q4: I pull over the lane-marking, in the middle of the road and overtake the cyclist.

195.s: You are driving at 70 km/h. The car, on your left, is driving slower. How will you continue?
195.q1: I pay special attention to the silver car on my left.
195.q2: I continue at the same speed of 70 km/h.
195.e2: No, you are not allowed to overtake the silver car on his right side.

196.s: You are towing another vehicle and would like to continue straight ahead. How will you continue?
196.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
196.q2: When I pass those two traffic signs, I will move to the lane on my right.
196.q3: I continue in the same lane for 200 meters and than change to the lane on my right.
196.q4: I speed up to 50 km/h and continue in the same lane.
196.e2: No. Not yet, the crawler lane starts 200 meters from here.
196.e4: No, the maximum speed when you are towing another vehicle is 30 km/h.

197.s: You would like to turn to the right at this junction. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
197.q1: I continue in the same lane and turn right at the junction.
197.q2: I cross the broken lines on my right and turn right from the lane beside me.
197.q3: I cross the broken lines on my right and enter the lane all the way to the right, close to the curb.
197.q4: I continue straight ahead in this junction and find a better place to turn right.
197.e1: No. You have to change to the right turn lane and from there you can turn to the right.

198.s: You intend to turn to the left.  What should you pay special attention to?
198.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic lights.
198.q2: I pay special attention to the road markings.
198.q3: I continue up to the white stop line and stop there.
198.q4: I stop before the yellow stop line.
198.e2: Yes, the yellow stop line applies here.

199.s: You intend to turn to the left. What should you pay special attention to?
199.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic lights.
199.q2: I stop before pedestrian crossing field.
199.q3: I continue with my left turn, immediately.
199.q4: I have to wait for the oncoming traffic.
199.e3: Yes. There is a traffic light with green arrow.
199.e4: No. There is a green arrow.

200.s: You have just left the black car. What are the rules about stopping and parking here?
200.q1: I am allowed to stop the car here for 2-3 minutes.
200.q2: I am allowed to park the car here 2-3 hours.
200.e2: No. It is a parking place only for lorries and busses. Here you may only stop but not park.(if you can see the undersign with the text TILLADT then you may also park the car). See also theory test 11. picture 25.

201.s: You are holding still by the curb and you would like to set off. What should you pay special attention to here?
201.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming cars.
201.q2: I look behind to see if there is traffic, approaching from behind.
201.q3: If there is no one in the blind spots, I will set off, right now.
201.q4: I wait a little bit longer.
201.e1: No, there are no oncoming cars.
201.e4: No, if it is free you will set off.

202.s: You are driving at 50 km/h. How will you continue?
202.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming bus.
202.q2: I reduce my speed a little.
202.q3: I continue with the same speed.
202.q4: I pull as much as possible to the right side of the road.
202.e2: No. There is enough space to pass the oncoming vehicle.

203.s: You are driving at app. 60 km/h. How will you continue?
203.q1: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of app. 60 km/h.
203.q3: I will use the position lights.
203.q4: I continue with the low beam on.
203.e1: No. Due to weather conditions there are reduced view abilities.
203.e3: No. Position/parking lights are used in order to be noticed when you park the car on the road.
203.e4: Yes. Low beam/dipped main lights are required when there is lighting up time which is from sunset to sunrise (and in fog, mist, heavy rain or snow).

204.s: You are driving at 70 km/h. What should you pay special attention to?
204.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming traffic.
204.q3: I continue with the same speed of 70 km/h.
204.q4: I pull to the lane marking, on the right side of the road.
204.e1: No. The oncoming traffic does not have an impact on your driving right now.
204.e4: No. You should stay in the middle of your lane.

205.s: You are driving at 60 km/h. How will you continue?
205.q1: I pay special attention to the oncoming car.
205.q2: I pay special attention to the traffic sign.
205.q3: I continue with the same speed of 60 km/h.
205.e4: No. The road is wide and you can continue with the same speed of 60 km/h

206.s: How fast will you drive here?
206.q1: I pay special attention to that I am entering a built-up area.
206.q2: I will continue with 50 km/h through the bend.
206.q4: After the sign, the maximum allowed speed is 50 km/h.
206.e4: Yes, but you will drive slow through the band.

207.s: What should you pay special attention to here?
207.q4: The rule of lane change applies a bit further.
207.e4: No. Rule of merge applies here.

208.s: You are driving 40-45 km/h in a built-up area. The car, behind you is driving 50 km/h. How will you continue?
208.q1: I slow down and let the car behind me merge in front of me.
208.q2: I continue with the same speed of 40-45 km/h.
208.q3: I speed up to 50 km/h and merge in front of the red car.
208.q4: The rule of lane change applies here.
208.e1: No. You should speed up and merge in front of the red car.
208.e4: No. Rule of merge applies here.

209.s: You are driving at 30 km/h. How will you continue?
209.q1: I pay special attention to the bus.
209.e1: Yes. The bus is entering the driving lane.

210.s: You are driving at app. 30 km/h and the lorry is moving slowly forward.  How will you continue?
210.q1: I pay special attention to the lorry maneuver abilities.
210.q2: I speed up and I drive pass the lorry.
210.q3: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 30 km/h.
210.q4: I stop and wait for the lorry.
210.e1: Yes. The lorry needs a lot of space for his maneuvers.
210.e2: No. The lorry should give way to you, but his position in the junction does not allow you to pass by.

211.s: You are driving at about 20-30 km/h. How will you continue?
211.q1: I continue with the same or almost the same speed.
211.q3: I pay special attention to the pedestrians.
211.q4: I am ready to stop before the pedestrian crossing field.

212.s: You are driving at about 45-50 km/h. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
212.q1: I continue with the same speed of 45-50 km/h.
212.q2: I move my foot to the brake.
212.q3: I pull further to the left of the lane.
212.q4: I pay special attention to the blue car on my right.
212.e4: Yes, the driver is opening his door.

213.s: You are driving at app. 40km/h. What should you pay special attention to?
213.q1: I pay special attention to the cyclist.
213.q2: I continue with the same or almost the same speed of 40 km/h.
213.e1: No, you have to pay special attention to the pedestrian?
213.e2: No, You have to stop and hold for the pedestrian.

214.s: You are driving very slowly and would like to continue straight ahead. The oncoming car is holding still. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
214.q1: I reverse in order to give way to the oncoming car.
214.q2: I stop here and wait until the oncoming car has passed.
214.q4: I continue at a low speed and move to the right between the parked cars.
214.e2: No. He is waiting for you.

215.s: You would like to turn to the left. How will you continue?
215.q1: I pay special attention to the traffic lights.
215.q2: I enter the junction and wait behind the black car.
215.q3: I enter the junction and wait behind the red car.
215.q4: I stop and wait a bit, before the pedestrian crossing field.
215.e2: No. There is not enough space for you to enter the junction. You have to be sure that you can leave the junction while the green light is on.

216.s: You are about to enter the roundabout. What should you pay special attention to here?
216.q1: The eventual pedestrians from the left and right sides.
216.q2: The eventual cyclists and moped drivers from the left and right sides.
216.q4: The eventual vehicles from my left.
216.e3: No, you can not meet oncoming vehicles in roundabout, only form your left.

217.s: Which lights will you use in this situation?
217.q3: The low beam or high beam.
217.q4: I have to use the fog lights.
217.e4: No. The fog light is not compulsory. However if your car is equipped with fog lights it would be recommended to use it in a situation like this.

218.s: You are driving at about 30 km/h. How will you continue?
218.q1: I continue with the same speed of 30 km/h.
218.q2: I cross the lines and overtake the riders with a good side distance straight away.
218.q3: I brake and stay behind the riders a little bit longer.
218.q4: I warn the riders with a short horn signal.
218.e4: No. You should only use horn to prevent a dangerous situation.

219.s: You are driving at 50 km/h in a built-up area and you are catching up with the vehicle in front of you, that is driving slower. There is a free rear view. How will you continue?
219.q1: I am particularly aware that I am approaching the railway crossing.
219.q2: I continue at the same speed of 50 km/h.
219.q4: I slow down and stay behind the green car.
219.e2: No, you are caching up the vehicle in front of you.
219.e3: No, overtaking before railway crossing is forbidden.

220.s: You have slowed down to turn right here. There are no pedestrians, on your right side. How will you continue?
220.q1: I turn to the right immediately.
220.q2: I look behind to the right.
220.q3: If there is no one behind to the right, I will turn right.
220.q4: I stop before the pedestrian crossing field and wait for the pedestrians.
220.e1: No, you have to look behind to the right?
220.e2: Yes. You have to check for cyclists and the like.
220.e4: No, they are far a way.

221.s: You are driving at 20-30 km/h and would like to turn left in this junction. The tractor on your right is moving slowly forward. How will you continue?
